get.description: Browser-only Passkey ceremony. Requires scoped X-Browser-Client, exact configured site Origin and CSRF for mutations. Challenges expire after 300 seconds and have one attempt. Registration requires a current password and a login completed within the last five minutes including existing MFA. User verification and resident credentials are required. Password fallback and existing MFA remain in force. Browser login returns only a scoped HttpOnly session projection, never a bearer token. Removing a credential revokes all account sessions and pending security/authorization proofs. Session exchange or token migration does not refresh the five-minute authentication assurance. Legacy sessions without a trusted authentication timestamp must sign in again. Origins use browser serialization, omitting default ports. No attestation certificates or private keys are retained.

delete.description: Self-service account deletion, disabled by default. Requires current password, explicit DELETE confirmation and a full login including configured MFA within five minutes. Administrators, balances, unsettled orders and commissions block deletion. Erases account identity and credentials, terminates subscription access, retains a pseudonymous accounting reference and necessary security records under existing retention rules. Irreversible; no automatic refund.

Provider-native signature verification and response. Payment notifications are idempotent; Telegram requires X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token. New payments use V10 callback URLs, including custom callback domains. Old payment callbacks remain compatible for existing orders. Historical callback URLs remain supported. PaytaroQR verifies X-App-Secret and requires positive order_amount (major units, up to two decimal places) and order_currency. Original order amount is converted to integer minor units and compared with the stored order total plus its payment fee snapshot; pay_amount/pay_currency are not settlement inputs. Valid and matching duplicate callbacks retain the native success response; invalid amount or currency returns the native failure response.

Uploaded drafts and historical packages not in the current release catalog return 404; current FastAI access/version policy applies. Supports HEAD and byte ranges; binary content is not enveloped. FastAI native YAML uses default.fastai.yaml or custom.fastai.yaml, independently of public subscription templates. Only real proxy nodes are emitted; subscription information nodes and subscription-userinfo headers are omitted. Account information is read through the account/subscription JSON APIs. Geo databases are bundled with FastAI; automatic Geo updates and remote HTTP rule providers are prohibited, including custom templates.

get.description: Static Linux sh entry point using official pinned v1.0.2 installer. Installs missing dependencies before re-executing bash. Default mode accepts --api-host/--node-id/--deploy-token for noninteractive installation (grant stdin remains compatible), checks the returned identity, and refuses configured nodes. Legacy URL/grant stdin remains supported. --install forwards subsequent arguments to the official installer for manual installation or configuration-preserving upgrade.

post.description: Burn a 10-minute one-use grant and issue one scoped credential. New grants supersede old grants. Credential/administrator changes invalidate grants; issuance does not happen until redemption. Lost responses require a new grant. No query tokens.

get.description: Returns only whether optional analytics is enabled and its retention period. No credentials required; no tracking identifier created.

post.description: First-party, consent-gated anonymous views, named guide actions, numeric performance samples and error categories. Exact allowed Origin, JSON only, 1024-byte maximum, 60 requests/minute per IP. No query parameters, credentials, user IDs, URLs, error messages or additional fields. GPC/DNT and disabled collection return 204 without recording. Non-view events do not inflate page views or the purchase funnel. Numeric metric values are required only for api_request/lcp/inp/cls. Histograms and a 200-sample/session cap make these estimates, not proof of payment, download or connection success. Browser family/major version, OS and embedded-app category are derived from a bounded request UA; raw UA and IP are not persisted in optional analytics. Guide views/actions require the same consent; copies do not prove external browser opening.
